There was no evil{NEWLINE}they wouldn’t do.{SCROLL}This woke three slumbering Pokémon: the{NEWLINE}Pillar of Rock,{SCROLL}the Pillar of Ice and the Pillar of{NEWLINE}Steel.{SCROLL}In their fury, they used Explosion and{NEWLINE}wiped out the villains.{SCROLL}To thank them, the people they saved{NEWLINE}renamed them the Rock God Pillar, Ice{CLEAR}God Pillar and Steel God Pillar.
